# NOAN adds fact rationales; evidence still needs human approval


By OpenTools Team


Optional reasons now follow fact versions through review and API readback, with private chat threads omitted.


##


A reason is not verified truth


NOAN’s November 3 update lets agents attach an optional source‑backed reason when creating or updating a fact. A request to change the record is not that reason: reviewers need evidence supporting the claim. NOAN says a person still verifies it.[November 3 entry](https://www.getnoan.com/changelog)


##


Readback has explicit gaps


The reason appears on approval cards, version history and decision details; absent reasons stay hidden. MCP fact listings and REST version reads return the rationale or null. The assistant’s chat thread is recorded as a private source and excluded from API returns, rather than disclosed alongside the rationale.[NOAN changelog](https://www.getnoan.com/changelog)


##


A broader design question


For the broader architecture decision, the[trusted‑memory and authority reference](https://opentools.ai/resources/enterprise-system-design) frames memory trust and audit boundaries as design questions. It is a learning resource rather than product‑control validation.


Reading and taking notes, February 2021; archive source‑and‑notes context, not NOAN’s interface or proof of verification.
